- PM2.5 can be considered into different levels. For the application, it shows six levels:
i) Good: AQI 0 ~ 50 
ii) Moderate: AQI 51 ~ 100
iii) Unhealthy for sensitive groups: AQI 101 ~ 150
iv) Unhealthy: AQI 151 ~ 200
v) Very Unhealthy: AQI 201 ~ 300
vi) Hazardous: Upper AQI 301
- It is very well recommended to wear a mask protecting PM2.5 when the air pollution around you is having AQI more than moderate level
